stories.title: InvestigateTV+: Firing college coaches can cost millions
stories.summary: Firing college football coaches can cost millions of dollars, and InvestigateTV+ has uncovered how, in some cases, students are helping to foot the bill.

stories.title: She married at 16. Now she’s fighting to end child marriage in Ohio
stories.summary: As the Siders family case draws renewed attention to child marriage in Ohio, a survivor speaks out to share her story of becoming a wife and mother at 16.

stories.title: This sculptor uses art to rise from grief
stories.summary: After losing his father, Jim Sardonis began constructing sculptures around Vermont. Now, his Whale Dance project attracts tourists from across the region.

stories.title: How to watch out for snakes and other dangerous critters
stories.summary: Weather fluctuations increase rattlesnake activity and cause them to pop up anywhere. Experts say people should take precautions while outside and around the home.

stories.title: Puppy wanders into car dealership after being abandoned and finds her forever home
stories.summary: For an abandoned 6-month-old puppy, wandering into a car dealership turned out to be the beginning of a second chance.

stories.title: City officials reassure residents of infrastructure’s resilience amid outages
stories.summary: After days of disruptions and outages nationwide, Honolulu officials are reassuring residents of the resilience of the island’s critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Water main break prompts lane closure in Aiea
stories.summary: Officials said crews were working in the far-right lane. One town-bound lane of Moanalua Road, near Honomanu Street, was closed.

stories.title: Mother charged after newborn dies from blunt force injuries 2 days after birth
stories.summary: Authorities say a 25-year-old woman has been charged with capital murder following the death of her newborn.

stories.title: UH engineering pathway gives Hawaii Island students a start closer to home
stories.summary: UH Hilo pre-engineering students toured UH Mānoa labs as they prepare to continue their studies through the pre-engineering pathway.

stories.title: Honolulu Liquor Commission chair resigns, citing red tape and harassment
stories.summary: In an exclusive interview, Jeffrey Hong said harassment and frustration with the agency’s inability to improve led to his resignation.

stories.title: Board of Water Supply chief Ernie Lau announces retirement
stories.summary: BWS manager and chief engineer Ernie Lau plans to retire in December 2027. The board will begin searching for his successor in the coming months.
